title: FFmpeg drawgraph: transition-count test harness with arithmetic baseline
purpose: Provides a verifiable arithmetic baseline for temporal luma analysis, directly testing Delta's claim that histogram and range checks alone cannot distinguish repeated flicker from a single brightness step. Supplies a CSV fixture with known expected values derivable by hand, plus a Python script to compute transition count and mean absolute step—the two measurements Delta argues must precede histogram buckets. Intended to be run against the fixture before trusting the script on real footage.
execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
